person_note: The event quotations repeatedly expose the same participating retrospective narrator through I, me, my, we, and explicit references to “this telling” and “getting all this down.” Generic or rhetorical you passages are advice, analogy, or direct address, not sustained second-person narration. Gnomic sayings, dialogue, the epigraph, and the dedication were treated as non-base material, while pronoun-free scene fragments were left unmarked. Authorized opening and interior excerpts independently sustain Demon’s first-person voice, and a scholarly whole-book source explicitly identifies Damon Fields/Demon Copperhead as the first-person narrator. No credible source or quote indicates sustained sections in another person; the only minor limitation is that the authorized prose samples do not reproduce the entire novel, which the whole-book structural description resolves.
